text:
nora: Quick heads-up — trial onboarding spike caused delayed tenant provisioning for ~23 trials created 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12. Drafting customer note + RCA. Need sign-off on credits + office hours.

devon: Thx. Scope = 23 accounts? can you paste a short list or sheet?

nora: Yes, 23. Internal sheet: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted-trials — top 5 high-touch: Acme, Lumen, KendraAI, Tidal, Scribble. Provisioning eventually succeeded after manual replay; a few had missing indexes we repaired.

marta: Recommend a 1hr office hours slot Tues 9am PT to walk through what happened and show the replay steps. Also propose offering a 25% credit for one month to affected trials. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

sam_ops: Root cause summary: delayed async webhook retries + transient lock contention in the indexer worker during a brief surge. Mitigation applied: removed locking hotspot, increased retry backoff, and kicked off backfills. Fix deployed 2026-03-13 02:40 UTC. Backfills in progress.

nora: Can you give me a concise RCA paragraph I can paste into the customer email? Keep it <=3 sentences.

sam_ops: Draft RCA: "A transient surge caused retries to accumulate in our provisioning queue and exposed a lock contention bug in the indexer worker. We deployed a fix to eliminate the contention and processed the backlog; affected tenants have been replayed and are being backfilled. We’re also adding additional retries and monitoring to prevent recurrence."

devon: That reads well. Add a sentence offering 1:1 migration help for the five high-touch accounts and an apology.

jules: I'll handle invites — scheduling office hours and collecting RSVPs. I'll include a short feedback survey after the session.

incident-bot: deploybot: release/2026-03-13-quick-fix deployed by @sam_ops at 2026-03-13T02:40Z :white_check_mark:

nora: Thanks. Action items: marta — confirm credit amount + customer email template by EOD; jules — schedule office hours + send invites; sam_ops — confirm backfill completion ETA in ~2h and post status here.

marta: :thumbsup: will confirm the 25% credit and paste the email copy here by 18:00 PT.

sam_ops: Backfills at ~30% complete as of now. New ETA for completion ~3.5 hours. Will update in this thread when done.

nora: If backfills don't finish in that window we'll offer an extension and schedule 1:1 follow-ups for the high-touch set. cc @devon for renewal risk flags.

devon: Noted — I'll flag the five at-risk accounts in Salesforce and ping AE owners to prep outreach.

nora: Appreciate it all. Once we have the final backfill confirmation I'll publish the customer note and send to the affected list.
